claim_text: By Sunday 16 August 2026 the Indiana Department of Homeland Security count had risen to a 4-year-old boy, three men and three women dead since the storms began on 11 August, spokesperson Liz Woods said, one man more than the toll given a day earlier.
quote: A 4-year-old boy, three men and three women were among those who had died since the storms began Aug. 11, said Liz Woods, a spokesperson for the state Department of Homeland Security.
confidence_justification: Same named agency spokesperson as the earlier count; the change from two men to three men is visible across the cluster's own reporting.
